data.name: Title_DoDevelopersSeeClientRates
data.value: Do developers see client billing rates in team mode?

data.name: Content_DoDevelopersSeeClientRates
data.value: No. In team mode, developers only see their personal earnings based on their internal rate (Member Rate). Company billing rates and client financial details remain completely protected and confidential.

data.name: Title_HowDoesCustomCurrencyWork
data.value: How does custom workspace currency work (e.g. the ₵ sign)?

data.name: Content_HowDoesCustomCurrencyWork
data.value: You can choose any standard currency (USD, EUR, UAH) or define custom credit units (such as internal workspace coins ₵) for calculations and accounting within your team.

data.name: Title_HowOftenClientReportsUpdated
data.value: How often is data updated in guest client reports?

data.name: Content_HowOftenClientReportsUpdated
data.value: Data updates in real time, but the client only sees entries that have been officially approved (Approved) by a manager. Any drafts, in-progress timers, or developer mistakes are never shown to the client.

data.name: Content_NoSetupComplexityJustAddAClientSetARate
data.value: No setup complexity. Just add a client, set a rate, and track time.
